questions.question: Which veteran filmmaker, recipient of the JC Daniel Award for the year 2023, passed away in April 2025?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Shaji N Karun) है।

questions.question: Who convened a joint meeting on 23 April 2025, with the Department of Biotechnology and other stakeholders to review the indigenously developed HPV test kits for cervical cancer screening in India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Dr. Jitendra Singh) है।

questions.question: In March 2025, who among the following was selected for the 59th Jnanpith Award?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Vinod Kumar Shukla) है।

questions.question: Under Article 29(1) of the Indian Constitution, which of the following is a right given to citizens?
options: Right to conserve their distinct language, script or culture
Right to establish and administer educational institutions
Right to form associations or unions
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Right to conserve their distinct language, script or culture) है।

questions.question: In March 2025, Lok Sabha Secretariat and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology signed an MoU to develop the Sansad Bhashini initiative for which purpose?
options: For tracking the activities of all the members
For digitising the Voter ID of all citizens
Enhancing and modernising of all government offices
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Streamline and modernise parliamentary operations) है।

questions.question: Why did the annexation of Avadh in 1856 anger the sepoys of the Company’s army?
options: The British banned regional festivals in Avadh.
The sepoys were forced to relocate to distant places, mostly southern India.
They were denied promotions in the army.
Most sepoys were from Avadh and resented foreign control over their homeland.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Most sepoys were from Avadh and resented foreign control over their homeland.) है।

questions.question: Which region will benefit the most from the Ken-Betwa River Linking Project?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Bundelkhand (Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh)) है।

questions.question: What separates the Little Andaman from the Great Andaman in the Andaman Islands group?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Duncan Passage) है।

questions.question: The famous Rath Yatra festival, where deities are taken in grand chariots to the Gundicha Temple, is primarily celebrated in which Indian state?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Odisha) है।

questions.question: Which Part and Articles of the Indian Constitution deal with the provisions related to High Courts?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Part VI, Articles 214 to 231) है।

questions.question: What is approximately the total installed power generation capacity of India as on 31 March 2025?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (475 GW) है।

questions.question: In November 2024, who delivered India’s National Statement at the High-level Segment of the CoP29 of UN Climate Change Conference at Baku, Azerbaijan?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Kirti Vardhan Singh) है।

questions.question: Plants that grow flowers and fruits belong to which group?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Angiosperms) है।

questions.question: Which of the following Indian leaders resigned from the Central Legislative Council in protest against the Rowlatt Act, 1919?
options: Mohammed Ali Jinnah, Madan Mohan Malaviya and Mazhar-ul-Huq
Bal Gangadhar Tilak, Bipin Chandra Pal and Lala Lajpat Rai
Gopal Krishna Gokhale, Dadabhai Naoroji and Lala Lajpat Rai
Jawaharlal Nehru, Sardar Patel and Subhas Chandra Bose
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Mohammed Ali Jinnah, Madan Mohan Malaviya and Mazhar-ul-Huq) है।

questions.question: The Indian Councils Act of 1892 was significant because it _____.
options: granted full autonomy and self-governance to selected Indian provinces
gave universal suffrage to Indians above the age of 18
introduced limited Indian representation in legislative councils
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (introduced limited Indian representation in legislative councils) है।

questions.question: Which authority notified the regulations for ‘Radar equipment for the measurement of the speed of vehicles’ in April 2025, set to come into force on 1 July 2025?
options: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Department of Consumer Affairs) है।

questions.question: Who was appointed as Prime Minister by the President using personal discretion after the sudden death of the sitting PM in 1984?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Rajiv Gandhi) है।

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY)?
options: To create employment through government-run industries in rural areas
To provide direct financial assistance to all villagers
To replace all existing rural development schemes
To empower villagers to make choices and develop their own model villages
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (To empower villagers to make choices and develop their own model villages) है।

questions.question: Which legislation replaced the Major Port Trusts Act, 1963?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Major Port Authorities Act, 2021) है।

questions.question: Which of the following best defines the ‘Current Weekly Status’ (CWS) used by India’s National Sample Survey Office?
options: The employment status based on the last 30 days
The activity status based on the last 7 days preceding the survey
The employment status over the past one year
The status of persons registered with employment exchanges
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (The activity status based on the last 7 days preceding the survey) है।
